criteria.text: Sets up a clear documentation structure for planning work (a plan, and places for feature specs, fix plans and audits).
Marks unknowns as to be decided instead of inventing a roadmap, features or stack details.
Leaves instructions for future contributors that state the stack, the documentation language and the commit convention given in the task.
Adds an ignore file that fits the stack and commits the setup in clean, conventional commits, leaving the existing code alone.
